---
title: "Intergenerational mobility"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Investigate how choice of record linkage algorithm affects research results 

```{r}
## library packages 
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
## occupation crosswalk (1950occ -> microclasses)
occupation_crosswalk <- fread(here("data", "occ1950_mc_xwalk_70.csv"))

## occ rank 
occ_classes <- fread(here("data", "ipums_data_occ_rank.csv"))

## occ classes 
occ_rank_1920 <- occ_classes[cohort == 1920, .(microocc, prank_1920 = prank)]
occ_rank_1940 <- occ_classes[cohort == 1940, .(microocc, prank_1940 = prank)]

## rank occupation classes 
occ_rank_1920 <- occ_rank_1920 %>% left_join(occupation_crosswalk %>% select(microocc, occ1950, occ1950_label))
occ_rank_1940 <- occ_rank_1940 %>% left_join(occupation_crosswalk %>% select(microocc, occ1950, occ1950_label))
```

```{r}
## read in census data 
## 1920: identify father-son pairs
roster_1920 <- fread("~/workspace/data/1920/P.tsv",
                     select = c("SERIALP", "PERNUM", "RELATE", "SEX", "AGE", 
                                "HISTID", "OCC1950")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

fathers_1920 <- roster_1920 %>% 
  filter(relate == 101, sex == 1, age >= 30, age <= 55) %>% 
  select(serialp, occ1950_father_1920 = occ1950, age_father_1920 = age)

sons_1920 <- roster_1920 %>% 
  filter(relate == 301, sex == 1, age <= 15) %>% 
  inner_join(fathers_1920, by = "serialp") %>% 
  rename_all(~ paste(., "1920", sep = "_"))

rm(roster_1920)

census_1940 <- fread("~/workspace/data/1940/P.tsv",
                     select = c("SEX", "AGE", "HISTID", "OCC1950")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  filter(sex == 1, age >= 25, age <= 45) %>% 
  rename_all(~ paste(., "1940", sep = "_"))

rm(fathers_1920)
```


```{r}
## mlp crosswalk 
mlp <- fread("~/workspace/data/crosswalks/mlp_census_crosswalk_v2_0.csv", select = c("histid_1940", "histid_1920")) %>%
  filter(histid_1940 != "" & histid_1920 != "")

## abe crosswalk 
abe <- fread("~/workspace/data/crosswalks/clp_1920_1940_xwalk/crosswalk_1920_1940.csv")
```

```{r}
## ---- Link sons_1920 -> 1940 via each crosswalk -----------------------------
## ABE: crosswalk has histid_1920, histid_1940, and the four indicator columns
linked_intergen_abe <- sons_1920 %>%
  inner_join(abe, by = c("histid_1920" = "histid_1920")) %>%
  inner_join(census_1940,   by = c("histid_1940" = "histid_1940"))

## MLP: same idea, different crosswalk file
linked_intergen_mlp <- sons_1920 %>%
  inner_join(mlp, by = c("histid_1920" = "histid_1920")) %>%
  inner_join(census_1940,   by = c("histid_1940" = "histid_1940"))
```
```{r}
## remove some stuff 
rm(abe, mlp)
rm(census_1940, sons_1920)
```



```{r}
## linked data abe 
linked_intergen_abe <- linked_intergen_abe %>% 
  left_join(occ_rank_1920, by = c("occ1950_father_1920_1920" = "occ1950")) %>% 
  left_join(occ_rank_1940, by = c("occ1950_1940" = "occ1950"))

linked_intergen_mlp <- linked_intergen_mlp %>% 
  left_join(occ_rank_1920, by = c("occ1950_father_1920_1920" = "occ1950")) %>% 
  left_join(occ_rank_1940, by = c("occ1950_1940" = "occ1950"))
```


```{r}
 ## ---- Intergenerational regression slopes ----------------------------------
get_slope_intergen <- function(df) {
  m <- lm(prank_1940 ~ prank_1920, data = df)
  tibble(
    slope = coef(m)[["prank_1920"]],
    se    = summary(m)$coefficients["prank_1920", "Std. Error"],
    n     = nobs(m)
  )
}

mlp_reg_inter <- get_slope_intergen(linked_intergen_mlp %>% filter(age_father_1920_1920 == age_1940)) %>% 
  mutate(variant = "mlp")

abe_reg_inter <- tibble(
  variant = c("exact_conservative", "exact_standard", "nysiis_conservative", "nysiis_standard")
) %>%
  mutate(stats = list(
    get_slope_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(age_father_1920_1920 == age_1940) %>% filter(abe_exact_conservative  == 1)),
    get_slope_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(age_father_1920_1920 == age_1940) %>% filter(abe_exact_standard      == 1)),
    get_slope_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(age_father_1920_1920 == age_1940) %>% filter(abe_nysiis_conservative == 1)),
    get_slope_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(age_father_1920_1920 == age_1940) %>% filter(abe_nysiis_standard     == 1))
  )) %>%
  unnest(stats)

intergenerational_mobility <- bind_rows(mlp_reg_inter, abe_reg_inter) %>% 
  mutate(algorithm = variant)

## ---- Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------
intergen_mobility_shifts <- intergenerational_mobility %>% 
  mutate(algorithm_cat = case_when(
    algorithm == "exact_conservative"  ~ "ABE Exact",
    algorithm == "exact_standard"      ~ "ABE Exact", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_conservative" ~ "ABE NYSIIS", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_standard"     ~ "ABE NYSIIS", 
    algorithm == "mlp"                 ~ "IPUMS MLP"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    algorithm == "exact_conservative"  ~ "Conservative  ",
    algorithm == "exact_standard"      ~ "Standard", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_conservative" ~ "Conservative  ", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_standard"     ~ "Standard", 
    algorithm == "mlp"                 ~ "Standard"
  )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(algorithm_cat, -slope), color = type, shape = type, 
             y = slope, ymin = slope - 1.96*se, ymax = slope + 1.96*se)) + 
  geom_pointrange(fill = "white", size = 1, position = position_dodge2(0.2)) + 
  theme_cowplot() + 
  labs(x = "Algorithm",
       y = "Rank-Rank Slope",
       title = "Intergenerational Mobility: Rank-Rank Slope") + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.3, 
           y = mean(intergenerational_mobility$slope) + 0.01, 
           label = "Mean", vjust = -1, color = "grey") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, .5)) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean(slope)), color = "grey", linetype = "dashed")

intergen_mobility_shifts
```

```{r}
## ---- Intergenerational Bottom-20 -> Top-20 transition rate ----------------
## Restricting to same age: father in 1920 and son in 1940 observed at same age
LOW  <- 20
HIGH <- 80

get_q1q10_intergen <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% 
    filter(!is.na(prank_1920), !is.na(prank_1940))
  
  bottom <- df %>% filter(prank_1920 < LOW)
  n_bottom <- nrow(bottom)
  n_made_it <- sum(bottom$prank_1940 > HIGH)
  
  ci <- if (n_bottom > 0) binom.test(n_made_it, n_bottom)$conf.int else c(NA, NA)
  
  tibble(
    n_total      = nrow(df),
    n_bottom     = n_bottom,
    n_q1_to_q10  = n_made_it,
    rate         = n_made_it / n_bottom,
    rate_lo      = ci[1],
    rate_hi      = ci[2],
    se           = sqrt(rate * (1 - rate) / n_bottom)
  )
}

mlp_q_inter <- get_q1q10_intergen(linked_intergen_mlp) %>% mutate(variant = "mlp")

abe_q_inter <- tibble(
  variant = c("exact_conservative", "exact_standard", "nysiis_conservative", "nysiis_standard")
) %>%
  mutate(stats = list(
    get_q1q10_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(abe_exact_conservative  == 1)),
    get_q1q10_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(abe_exact_standard      == 1)),
    get_q1q10_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(abe_nysiis_conservative == 1)),
    get_q1q10_intergen(linked_intergen_abe %>% filter(abe_nysiis_standard     == 1))
  )) %>%
  unnest(stats)

q1_to_q10_intergen <- bind_rows(mlp_q_inter, abe_q_inter) %>% 
  mutate(algorithm = variant)

q1_to_q10_intergen

## ---- Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------
rags_to_riches_intergen <- q1_to_q10_intergen %>% 
  mutate(algorithm_cat = case_when(
    algorithm == "exact_conservative"  ~ "ABE Exact",
    algorithm == "exact_standard"      ~ "ABE Exact", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_conservative" ~ "ABE NYSIIS", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_standard"     ~ "ABE NYSIIS", 
    algorithm == "mlp"                 ~ "IPUMS MLP"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    algorithm == "exact_conservative"  ~ "Conservative  ",
    algorithm == "exact_standard"      ~ "Standard", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_conservative" ~ "Conservative  ", 
    algorithm == "nysiis_standard"     ~ "Standard", 
    algorithm == "mlp"                 ~ "Standard"
  )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(algorithm_cat, rate), color = type, shape = type, 
             y = rate, ymin = rate_lo, ymax = rate_hi)) + 
  geom_pointrange(fill = "white", size = 1, position = position_dodge2(0.2)) + 
  theme_cowplot() + 
  labs(x = "Algorithm",
 y = "Upward Mobility \n (Son Top 20%; Father Bottom 20%)",
       title = "Intergenerational Mobility: Bottom-to-Top ") + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.3, y = mean(q1_to_q10_intergen$rate), 
           label = "Mean", vjust = -1, color = "grey") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.07)) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean(rate)), color = "grey", linetype = "dashed")

rags_to_riches_intergen
```

intergenerational_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(rags_to_riches_intergen, intergen_mobility_shifts, ncol = 1, labels = c("B", "D"))

ggsave(plot = intergenerational_plot, filename = here("figures", "intergenerational_plot.png"), height = 10, width = 6)
